title: 夜市小吃
question:
小吃攤販有六種食物，品項與價格如下。
請建立價格陣列，輸入遊客有多少錢（元），輸出可以買的起幾種小吃。

test_case.note: 可以買炸雞排、奶茶、臭豆腐、地瓜球，共四種

en.title: Night Market Food
en.question:
A night market shop has six foods. Here are the foods and prices.
Make a list of the prices. Input how much money you have. Output how many foods you can buy.

test_case.note: You can buy fried chicken, milk tea, stinky tofu, and sweet potato balls. Four foods
